  26: def find_numeral_symbol_tokens(tokenizer):
  27:     numeral_symbol_tokens = []
  28:     for i in range(tokenizer.eot):
  29:         token = tokenizer.decode([i]).removeprefix(" ")
  30:         has_numeral_symbol = any(c in "0123456789%$£" for c in token)
  31:         if has_numeral_symbol:
  32:             numeral_symbol_tokens.append(i)
  33:     return numeral_symbol_tokens

  35: class WhisperModel(faster_whisper.WhisperModel):
  36:     '''
  37:     FasterWhisperModel provides batched inference for faster-whisper.
  38:     Currently only works in non-timestamp mode and fixed prompt for all samples in batch.
  39:     '''
  40: 
  41:     def generate_segment_batched(
  42:         self,
  43:         features: np.ndarray,
  44:         tokenizer: Tokenizer,
  45:         options: TranscriptionOptions,
  46:         encoder_output=None,
  47:     ):
  48:         batch_size = features.shape[0]
  49:         all_tokens = []
  50:         prompt_reset_since = 0
  51:         if options.initial_prompt is not None:
  52:             initial_prompt = " " + options.initial_prompt.strip()
  53:             initial_prompt_tokens = tokenizer.encode(initial_prompt)
  54:             all_tokens.extend(initial_prompt_tokens)
  55:         previous_tokens = all_tokens[prompt_reset_since:]
  56:         prompt = self.get_prompt(
  57:             tokenizer,
  58:             previous_tokens,
  59:             without_timestamps=options.without_timestamps,
  60:             prefix=options.prefix,
  61:             hotwords=options.hotwords
  62:         )
  63: 
  64:         encoder_output = self.encode(features)
  65:         
  66:         result = self.model.generate(
  67:                 encoder_output,
  68:                 [prompt] * batch_size,
  69:                 beam_size=options.beam_size,
  70:                 patience=options.patience,
  71:                 length_penalty=options.length_penalty,
  72:                 max_length=self.max_length,
  73:                 suppress_blank=options.suppress_blank,
  74:                 suppress_tokens=options.suppress_tokens,
  75:                 no_repeat_ngram_size=options.no_repeat_ngram_size,
  76:                 repetition_penalty=options.repetition_penalty,
  77:                 return_scores=True,
  78:             )
  79: 
  80:         tokens_batch = [x.sequences_ids[0] for x in result]
  81: 
  82:         avg_logprobs = []
  83:         for res in result:
  84:             seq_len = len(res.sequences_ids[0])
  85:             cum_logprob = res.scores[0] * (seq_len ** options.length_penalty)
  86:             avg_logprobs.append(cum_logprob / (seq_len + 1))
  87: 
  88:         def decode_batch(tokens: List[List[int]]) -> List[str]:
  89:             res = []
  90:             for tk in tokens:
  91:                 res.append([token for token in tk if token < tokenizer.eot])
  92:             # text_tokens = [token for token in tokens if token < self.eot]
  93:             return tokenizer.tokenizer.decode_batch(res)
  94: 
  95:         text = decode_batch(tokens_batch)
  96: 
  97:         return {'text': text, 'avg_logprob': avg_logprobs}

  99:     def encode(self, features: np.ndarray) -> ctranslate2.StorageView:
 100:         # When the model is running on multiple GPUs, the encoder output should be moved
 101:         # to the CPU since we don't know which GPU will handle the next job.
 102:         to_cpu = self.model.device == "cuda" and len(self.model.device_index) > 1
 103:         # unsqueeze if batch size = 1
 104:         if len(features.shape) == 2:
 105:             features = np.expand_dims(features, 0)
 106:         features = get_ctranslate2_storage(features)
 107: 
 108:         return self.model.encode(features, to_cpu=to_cpu)

 121:         vad,

 133:         self.options = options
 134:         self.preset_language = language
 135:         self.suppress_numerals = suppress_numerals
 136:         self._batch_size = kwargs.pop("batch_size", None)
 137:         self._num_workers = 1
 138:         self._preprocess_params, self._forward_params, self._postprocess_params = self._sanitize_parameters(**kwargs)
 139:         self.call_count = 0
 140:         self.framework = framework
 141:         if self.framework == "pt":
 142:             if isinstance(device, torch.device):
 143:                 self.device = device
 144:             elif isinstance(device, str):
 145:                 self.device = torch.device(device)
 146:             elif device < 0:
 147:                 self.device = torch.device("cpu")
 148:             else:

 157:     def _sanitize_parameters(self, **kwargs):
 158:         preprocess_kwargs = {}
 159:         if "tokenizer" in kwargs:
 160:             preprocess_kwargs["maybe_arg"] = kwargs["maybe_arg"]
 161:         return preprocess_kwargs, {}, {}

 163:     def preprocess(self, audio):
 164:         audio = audio['inputs']
 165:         model_n_mels = self.model.feat_kwargs.get("feature_size")
 166:         features = log_mel_spectrogram(
 167:             audio,
 168:             n_mels=model_n_mels if model_n_mels is not None else 80,
 169:             padding=N_SAMPLES - audio.shape[0],
 170:         )
 171:         return {'inputs': features}

 173:     def _forward(self, model_inputs):
 174:         outputs = self.model.generate_segment_batched(model_inputs['inputs'], self.tokenizer, self.options)
 175:         return outputs

 196:         dataloader = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(dataset, num_workers=num_workers, batch_size=batch_size, collate_fn=stack)
 197:         model_iterator = PipelineIterator(dataloader, self.forward, forward_params, loader_batch_size=batch_size)

 201:     def transcribe(
 202:         self,
 203:         audio: np.ndarray,
 204:         batch_size: Optional[int] = None,
 205:         num_workers=0,
 206:         language: Optional[str] = None,
 207:         task: Optional[str] = None,

 216:         def data(audio, segments):

 224:         # selection or construction is performed during transcription.
 225:         require_owned_runtime().assert_model_binding(self.model_path, self.vad_model)

 227:         merge_chunks = Pyannote.merge_chunks

 229:         vad_segments = self.vad_model({"waveform": waveform, "sample_rate": SAMPLE_RATE})
 230:         vad_segments = merge_chunks(

 232:             chunk_size,
 233:             onset=self._vad_params["vad_onset"],
 234:             offset=self._vad_params["vad_offset"],
 235:         )
 236:         if self.tokenizer is None:
 237:             language = language or self.detect_language(audio)
 238:             task = task or "transcribe"
 239:             self.tokenizer = Tokenizer(
 240:                 self.model.hf_tokenizer,
 241:                 self.model.model.is_multilingual,
 242:                 task=task,
 243:                 language=language,
 244:             )
 245:         else:
 246:             language = language or self.tokenizer.language_code
 247:             task = task or self.tokenizer.task
 248:             if task != self.tokenizer.task or language != self.tokenizer.language_code:
 249:                 self.tokenizer = Tokenizer(
 250:                     self.model.hf_tokenizer,
 251:                     self.model.model.is_multilingual,
 252:                     task=task,
 253:                     language=language,
 254:                 )
 255: 
 256:         if self.suppress_numerals:
 257:             previous_suppress_tokens = self.options.suppress_tokens
 258:             numeral_symbol_tokens = find_numeral_symbol_tokens(self.tokenizer)
 259:             logger.info("Suppressing numeral and symbol tokens")
 260:             new_suppressed_tokens = numeral_symbol_tokens + self.options.suppress_tokens
 261:             new_suppressed_tokens = list(set(new_suppressed_tokens))
 262:             self.options = replace(self.options, suppress_tokens=new_suppressed_tokens)
 263: 
 264:         segments: List[SingleSegment] = []
 265:         batch_size = batch_size or self._batch_size
 266:         total_segments = len(vad_segments)
 267:         for idx, out in enumerate(self.__call__(data(audio, vad_segments), batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=num_workers)):
 268:             if print_progress:
 269:                 base_progress = ((idx + 1) / total_segments) * 100
 270:                 percent_complete = base_progress / 2 if combined_progress else base_progress
 271:                 print(f"Progress: {percent_complete:.2f}%...")
 272:             if progress_callback is not None:
 273:                 progress_callback(((idx + 1) / total_segments) * 100)
 274:             text = out['text']
 275:             avg_logprob = out['avg_logprob']
 276:             if batch_size in [0, 1, None]:
 277:                 text = text[0]
 278:                 avg_logprob = avg_logprob[0]
 279:             if verbose:
 280:                 print(f"Transcript: [{round(vad_segments[idx]['start'], 3)} --> {round(vad_segments[idx]['end'], 3)}] {text}")
 281:             segments.append(
 282:                 {
 283:                     "text": text,
 284:                     "start": round(vad_segments[idx]['start'], 3),
 285:                     "end": round(vad_segments[idx]['end'], 3),
 286:                     "avg_logprob": avg_logprob,
 287:                 }
 288:             )
 289: 
 290:         # revert the tokenizer if multilingual inference is enabled
 291:         if self.preset_language is None:
 292:             self.tokenizer = None
 293: 
 294:         # revert suppressed tokens if suppress_numerals is enabled
 295:         if self.suppress_numerals:
 296:             self.options = replace(self.options, suppress_tokens=previous_suppress_tokens)
 297: 
 298:         return {"segments": segments, "language": language}

 300:     def detect_language(self, audio: np.ndarray) -> str:
 301:         audio = validate_waveform(audio)
 302:         if audio.shape[0] < N_SAMPLES:
 303:             logger.warning("Audio is shorter than 30s, language detection may be inaccurate")
 304:         model_n_mels = self.model.feat_kwargs.get("feature_size")
 305:         segment = log_mel_spectrogram(audio[: N_SAMPLES],
 306:                                       n_mels=model_n_mels if model_n_mels is not None else 80,
 307:                                       padding=0 if audio.shape[0] >= N_SAMPLES else N_SAMPLES - audio.shape[0])
 308:         encoder_output = self.model.encode(segment)
 309:         results = self.model.model.detect_language(encoder_output)
 310:         language_token, language_probability = results[0][0]
 311:         language = language_token[2:-2]
 312:         logger.info(f"Detected language: {language} ({language_probability:.2f}) in first 30s of audio")
 313:         return language
